key_insight: GenEHR is an autoregressive EHR generative model that learns from irregular patient timelines and can be adapted to improve pan-cancer risk stratification.
clinical_relevance: In retrospective testing across five large EHR cohorts, the adapted model improved prediction of first cancer diagnosis within five years, suggesting potential for risk-based screening prioritization.
method: Trained on longitudinal electronic health records from millions of patients.
Explicitly models irregular time gaps between clinical visits while forecasting future events.
Uses parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for pan-cancer risk stratification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports retrospective evaluation in five large EHR cohorts, where supervised adaptation substantially improved five-year first-cancer prediction performance.
watch_item: Because the results are retrospective, prospective validation is still needed before clinical decision-support use.
paper_title: Generative model of patient health states and pan-cancer risk stratification
